[[File:Chris DeJong DecipherCon 1999 sat47.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Chris DeJong at [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Chris DeJong''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 68 in the Alderaan region, from Davis, California.<ref name="decsq-alderaan" /> His slot was later marked Retired.<ref name="sm-fan" />

At [[DecipherCon 1999]] Decipher photographed "Star Trek CCG finalist Chris DeJong of Davis, California" on Saturday 13 November 1999.<ref name="sat47">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat47.html DecipherCon 1999 photo sat47], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000711124430/http://www.decipher.com:80/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat47.html Internet Archive]</ref>

In [[Star Trek CCG]] he won the 1998 Risa Regional in Mountain View, California, which qualified him for the 1998 Star Trek CCG World Championship.<ref name="st98-qual">[http://www.decipher.com/startrek/specialevents/current/regionalqualifiers/qualifiers.htm Star Trek CCG World Championships 1998: qualifiers], Decipher (1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19981203093930/http://www.decipher.com:80/startrek/specialevents/current/regionalqualifiers/qualifiers.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="st98-bio">[http://www.decipher.com/startrek/specialevents/current/regionalqualifiers/dejongbio.htm Chris DeJong], Star Trek CCG World Championships 1998 finalist biography, Decipher (1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990203115236/http://www.decipher.com:80/startrek/specialevents/current/regionalqualifiers/dejongbio.htm Internet Archive]</ref> He made the Top 12 there.<ref name="st98-decks">[http://www.decipher.com/startrek/specialevents/98worldfinals/decklists.htm Star Trek CCG 1998 World Championships: deck lists], Decipher (1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990220111725/http://decipher.com:80/startrek/specialevents/98worldfinals/decklists.htm Internet Archive]</ref> In 1999 he won the Comic Con Invitational and finished 20th of 32 in the Star Trek CCG World Championship at [[DecipherCon 1999]].<ref name="st-finalists">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/stworldchamp/finalists.html Meet the 1999 Star Trek CCG World Championship Finalists], Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011005154442/http://www.decipher.com:80/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/stworldchamp/finalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="st02">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/ST02_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: 1999 ST World Championships], Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001031210057/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/ST02_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>
